feature: Pre-score blame bonus for localization_blame candidates

AC2: Pre-score formula becomes: base_score + blame_bonus. Blame bonus is additive, not replacing existing formula
AC3: P28 pre-score failures rescued: SPARK-27907 (rank 46→top 20) and GROOVY-7014 (rank 29→top 20)
AC4: P28 triage failures rescued: GROOVY-5775 (rank 13→top 7) and GROOVY-8298 (rank 5→stabilized in top 7)
AC5: No regression on existing hits — cases already passing should not degrade
AC6: All existing tests pass (python -m pytest --tb=short -q)
AC7: ScoredCandidate gains optional blame_bonus field for observability in diagnostics
edge_cases: Candidate has localization_blame AND other high signals (e.g., IGNITE-6748 with 4 signals) — should not overflow or create score >1.0 issues
Candidate has only localization_blame (e.g., GROOVY-7014 with SC=1) — blame_bonus should still apply
No candidates have localization_blame (fix_hash=None mode) — zero behavior change
verification_method: run_phase1_checkpoint.py gate + n=20 eval (Hit@5 >= 0.700, no regression on 13 existing hits)
